test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In May 2021, which of the following ministries had organized the Virtual Vesak Global Celebrations on Buddha Purnima?

options.text: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Culture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** International Buddhist Confederation **collaborated with the Ministry of Culture, Government of India to organise the **global online Vesak – Buddha Poornima** celebrations on a** digital platform** on** 26 May 2021**.
 
• It witnessed the participation of all the** supreme heads of the Buddhist Sanghas **from all around the world.** Over 50 **most prominent Buddhist religious leaders from around the world.
 
• **Buddha Purnima** is celebrated to mark the** birth of Gautam Buddha**, the founder of Buddhism. It is considered a** 'triple-blessed day'** - as **Tathagata Gautam Buddha's birth, enlightenment and Maha Parnirvana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Union Minister for the Ministry of Culture **is** G. Kishan Reddy** and the** Minister of State** for the Ministry of Culture is** Meenakshi Lekhi**.
 
• The** Union Minister for Food Processing Industries** is **Shri Pashupati Kumar Paras** and the** Minister of State** for Food Processing Industries is **Shri Prahlad Singh Patel**.
 
• The** Union Minister for the Ministry of Labour and Employment** is **Bhupender Yadav** and the** ****Minister of State** for the Ministry of Labour and Employment is **Shri Rameswar Teli**.
 
• The** Union Minister for the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy **is ** Raj Kumar Singh** and the **Minister of State** for the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy is **Bhagwanth Khutba**.
